reviews.comment: On the very first day he told us that he doesn't "teach", he professes and lectures were him reading ppt slides. No in class experiments, never solved a single question in class, attendance was compulsory. He's not bad but other professors have a much better and more fun physics learning experience.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He teaches at a fundamental level, making his explanations very clear. He also emphasizes his eagerness to help. He's proud of his students. Lecture is very enjoyable, and he has good stories.

Dr. May's lectures are amazing, clear and interesting. If you need extra help his office hours are a good resource and he can really break down any problem. The homework does take a long time so don't leave it to the last minute. As long as you do the homework yourself, read the textbook, and take practice tests you'll do good.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I like Dr. May but he makes things harder than they should be

207 is a really tough course but Dr. May is really good at explaining the material. The only problem I had was that I had lecture at 8AM and probably missed more classes than I actually went to. He is very accessible outside of class and is a great professor.

I struggled with physics going into the class, but Dr. May explained concepts in a way that made them easier to understand. iClicker was used for attendance and participation. His lectures had some humor, which helped keep things engaging. Exams were challenging for me, but keeping up with the homework and practice problems made a big difference.

Great and very funny professor, makes 206 very enjoyable. His lectures can sometimes just be solving problems and less explaining concepts, but his office hours are great. He knows a lot about physics and tries to teach the class to be able to use it effectively in real life.

Very good lecturer plus he is the course coordinator, so he is the best for teaching you what you need to know for the exam. Class has lots of homework and reading but if you do all of this and pay attention during the lectures you will be fine.
One of the most underrated PHYS 206/207 profs out there. Great lecturer, very funny, and cares about your grade. Take him if you can!

Dr. May is an amazing guy. His humour is tough to understand if you're not similar to him. Luckily, I have the same so we connected easily in office hours. Super fair on grading/policies overall. He knows so much about physics and sparked my love for the subject in 206. Yes it's hard, but it's important. The meaning of the material gives it value.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. May is a very funny guy, and he understands what he is lecturing about, and can explain it succinctly to the class. He takes time to make sure students understand the course, and is very accessible outside of class. He made learning Physics interesting, and I'm glad that I had the chance to be in his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. May is a great guy and he really understands physics, I mean he does have many years of studying it under his belt. This class curriculum is very much teach yourself with reading a book which sucks so much time out of your week. Definitely an easy class if professors covered important material in class and not easy problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. May is a goated prof and he will try to help you in any way he can, his only job is to help students and really does care about us. People also complain about the difficulty of PHYS 207 however most people don't put the effort in to do the homework without chatgpt or chegg or ask for help during office hours. The threshold for a C is a 60 btw.

I strongly do not recommend him. He makes up his own tests. Prepare to work the text book homework and get nothing like it at the test. Questions are confusing, overly complicated, and sometimes incomplete. The upper quartile for test was 67, few turned in empty scantrons and dropped. Other professors teaching the same class have averages in 90s.

Frequent profanity. 206 common exams but icklicker and teaching style differs. TAKE DONT PANIC - ITS EASIER THAN UNIVERSITY. dont panic has barely any hw but university hw takes HOURS. university exams were SO MUCH HARDER He did frequent icklickers His slides were helpful but are accessible from any prof. exam 3 was impossible but my final replaced
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Excellent lectures and very helpful during office hours, but exams (especially the 2nd and 3rd) were pretty difficult and the homework could be very time-consuming. He clearly laid out what was expected of us though and provided a lot of resources to practice the content (past exams, extra optional homework, recitation, etc.).

The university physics course and exams are common between professors, but Prof. May is by far the best one. His lectures are super detailed and he is good at explaining problems that may help you on the exam. Make sure you dedicate a lot of time outside of class to study and do the homework as it helps a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. May is really funny and a good lecturer. I felt like the problems during lecture were significantly easier than the ones on the exams but since it's a common exam, you can use all the past exams to study (and I highly recommend you do). Difficult subject but Dr. May was always available by email to answer any questions.

I would tell you not to take this prof, but somehow he might be the best option. Not very amicable during lectures, which he always wasted a third of and the other two thirds were basically useless. Test heavy and iclicker during classes so you have to waste your time with the lectures.

I personally didn't gain much from lectures, but he's pretty entertaining and iClicker is a grade so go to class.  Homework is all due right before the respective exam so DONT PROCRASTINATE.  Take lots of practice exams.  For honors we had to do a group project at the end and it was super chill.  Recitiation is annoying but attendance is mandatory.

May is the best prof you can get for PHYS 206. Do not get behind and make sure you do homework weeks in advance. My recitation was told by another professor over the department that the course is intentionally being made to be harder especially on exams, so buckle up.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy is so funny for real, but he also really knows his stuff. Very good at making a difficult class easier by listening to him during lecture explain it in a simple way to understand. Does iclicker so make sure you go to class but trust me you're going to want to go once you hear this guy. Taking PHYS 207 with him again in the fall.

Dr. May is the GOAT. He is probably the best university professor, and his lectures are very engaging. He will usually do an iClicker (attendance) 60% of the time so attendance is important. At the end of the day Physics 206 is a very standardized course so all homework and exams are identical for University Physics regardless of professor.

The best prof for this class! He is the course coordinator so he makes the tests and so he teaches in order to help u better prepare for the test, def recommend him for university physic. Is very easy to reach out to if u have questions and will tell u in class when he may not be available.
Great professor, but i hated the material so I didnt pay attention. C is as low as a 60, B as low as a 75. Pay attention in class and actually do the homework and a B is very gettable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof. Helped me out so much in the semester and has great lectures. He really cares and tries to make himself as available as possible to students in 1 on 1 meetings and office hours almost everyday.

Good guy, it's clear that he cares about his students. The material is just hard, so get ready to put in time if you really want a good grade. He makes his lectures as helpful as can be, and also has iclicker. Very easy to reach outside of class, and wants you to reach out. Super cool guy, never wears pants above 60 degrees.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. May is a funny guy (very millennial core) with pretty good lectures and detailed lecture slides. The class is just pretty hard, and you need to study A LOT if you want to do well. He is available outside of class often and cares about his students. The class is just difficult in general though good luck.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: barely any iclicker so it matters, kinda unorganized, yaps a lot, genuine guy but I think a prof like kaya is better
Phys 207 is a hard class, but Dr May is the best professor you could have. He does a great job explaining material in the way that students think.
Study a lot to do well in this class! Larry May cares about his students and he has the most thorough lecture slides out of all the teachers. Review the slides before the exam, and you will be set.

Overall, the professor is hilarious and has a great personality. He makes jokes throughout the lecture which sort of helps us to focus on the lecture. Sometimes, i-clicker can be a little bit stressful as it is 6% of your grade, but it is doable. There's just so much HW that may/may not help you for the mid-terms(Past paper >). The final was easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He spent 5-10 min every day talking about how we don't come to class. He's an OK teacher, but his personality made me not want to come to class. I studied about 8 hours every day 5 days before every test, and that's why I did well on the tests. Other professors don't teach as well, so he's the best of the worst. Wouldn't recommend for an 8 am.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: May is by far the best physics professor available for engineering students. I had him for 206 as well and am glad I had him for 207. The class is very hard due to the material; however, he gives great lectures and host offices hours constantly. It is easy to tell he cares about your success but does make it clear that you have to put in the time.

Dr. May is seriously the best Physics professor for 206. I've heard horror stories about other professors. He has accessible office hours and even shows up to some recitations to answer questions. Had him at 8am and it was absolutely worth it. He is really funny and keeps it real. Definitely worth manipulating your schedule for this guy.
Larry makes physics easy. His class is significantly easier than Don't Panic.

Honestly this class calls for a LOT of reading. The lectures only covered the basic concepts so they weren't really useful in my opinion. The most important part of this class was the homework and recitation that you do. MAKE SURE you do the homework before the recitation that way you get as much practice as possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: It's funny, I didn't think much of him as a professor. He seems like a nice guy and genuinely wants to help his students; however, I found his lectures to be quite rudimentary. If you watched the pre-lecture & read the textbook, then you don't really get anything out of class. Number of degrading engineering jokes were obnoxious.

Dr. May is by far the best professor I have had. He answers emails fast, and does his best to help students. Lectures are great, but be ready to start the homework early because it is a lot. Overall, he made a difficult class that much easier.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The lecture are a bit meh because he derives every problem, but he's still a great prof. If you do the hw immediately (bc it is a lot) and not wait to do it, and study for the test with the previous tests it's honestly not that bad of a course. He answers his emails fast and his office hours are very helpful.

Dr. May is one of the best professors I've had. He managed to come into our 8 am classes with energy, which I really appreciate. The tests and assignments were graded very fairly and were often very similar to practice tests. I cannot recommend him enough.

His summer class was super fast pace, and honeslty most people who got good grades on his exam were because they attended Tutor John. If you have no money to pay for a tutor then good luck studying. There is no curving at the end of the summer semester but his exams were not terribly hard.

By far the best professor I had during my freshman year. He gave me every tool to be successful and would go over past exam questions before exams. He is also just a great dude. Take him if you can, 11/10 professor.

Very kind, approachable, and willing to help you out. Physics is just tough but if you ask him for help when you're immediately confused, he'll help you at your level. Just make sure to put in the work because it's not going to just make sense after him lecturing over it.

Dr.May is a very middle-of-the-road professor. He gets the job done as far as feeding you the content needed for the exam but I would not say his lectures are the most detailed in the world. He is a very funny and caring guy despite this and I would say I had a relatively good time in his class. Solid but not top-notch.

Professor May was a great professor and very engaging. He would meet outside of class and tried to make lectures engaging. The only thing is his handwriting was illegible and he went really fast through stuff so I had to do a lot of work outside of class and was still really struggling.

He cares for your success and if you take the opportunity he provides, you can succeed. Physics, especially at this level, is not beyond the grasp of anyone, and he will support you so you can succeed if you ask for help and put in the reasonable amount of work. He cares, he is accessible, he is fun, and he is worth taking.

Amazing professor. He has a great attitude and makes lectures enjoyable. He teaches physics really well and does a lot of example problems during class. Very helpful at answering questions. He responds to emails usually within 24 hours and always has office hours available. If you have to take PHYS 207, I would definitely recommend taking Dr. May.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was the hardest class I have ever taken in all of my college career, I would highly recommend you do the class online at a junior college however if you do end up taking it here its good to get May, his class is insanely hard but he is willing to bend over backward to ensure your success. Hard expectations but again, helps you if you ask
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. May was probably the most accessible prof I have had at TAMU. The class was hard but his lectures were amazing and he was easy to understand. He is also very open to helping students for whatever reason if something is going on. 100% recommend.
Amazing professor. Course material is difficult but Dr. May will take the time to help his students understand.

I took physics 1 with Dr. May for the 5 week summer and it wasn't easy but Dr. May made it manageable. He is very passionate and his lectures are helpful. His test problems are like the ones in class and are easier than the hw. The hw is hard and a lot but if you master it the tests are easy. study the practice tests before exams and you'll be set.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took him as a 5 week summer course and it was BRUTAL, however Dr. May truly cares about his student's success. He went out of his way to be accessible. There is a lot of homework, and tests were hard. He did provide practice exams which helped. He curved and changed letter grade cutoffs. 201 is a very hard class, but he makes it doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: took in a 5 wk summer course so it was very brutal but he def made it manageable. great prof great lectures hard exams no extra credit "no curve" but had a large one. he is actually here to teach us&wants us to learn&pass. one of the best/most caring profs i've had at tamu. just do yourself a favor&take this class with this him oh&he's super funny!

*Summer 1* Ok so physics is just hard but Dr. May actually made this class somewhat enjoyable, like i didn't dread going to class. He is super funny and truly wants everyone to succeed. Go to his office hours for help/tutoring. No extra credit. Claims to not curve but curved exam 1 20 pts and exam 2 35 pts. TAKE HIM FOR PHYS! Literally the best :-)

This class is super hard but he is such a good professor. tons of work tho so be ready. and do NOT take this class during a 5 week summer period if it's your first time taking it. It goes unreasonably fast and you will hate yourself every day. But take this professor!!!

Dr. May is an all-around great professor. Really made me want to do better as a student in his class, and taught the material in a way that was super easy to understand (even though its a really tough class). Would definitely recommend him to any engineer that needs to take Electromagnetism!!

Dr. May is a very caring professor. He wants his students to do well in the course. He said that he does not do research as a prof so that he can dedicate all of his time to teaching and that shows. But you must put in the work to get through a tough class. This class is required for engineers and it is not easy, but Dr. May makes it enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. May is awesome. This was a 5-week course, so it was hell, but he somehow managed to concisely explain all of the material normally contained in four months of physics lectures. He really, really cares for his students, but will still make you work hard for your grade. BE PREPARED FOR THE FIRST EXAM. It throws a lot of people off.

Dr. May is sincerely a great professor. Great lectures full of personal stories to relate to the material, and he makes himself incredibly accessible to help out his students as much as possible. Since this is a five-week E&M course, it's naturally a very difficult class, but Dr. May makes it doable. If you have the choice, take his classes!
Professor May has officially been GOATed. He's a great professor that cares about his students. He explains things very clearly. This class is a breath of fresh air. 10/10 professor.
